com.vector.cfg.gen.core.genusage.groovy.api

Interface IGenerationReportApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface IGenerationReportApi
    IGenerationReportApi is the entry point for generation report settings. When the settings are set and generation has been finished, the report output path can be seen in the "Configurator Console View".
    IGenerationReportApi i

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.
